title: Polyethylene glycol-liposomal doxorubicin triggers ferroptosis in breast cancer through the KEAP1/NRF2 signaling pathway.
authors: Shen, Yuanyuan; Hua, Qingling; Wang, Jinnan; Dong, Menghao; Li, Wencheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脂质体阿霉素通过KEAP1/NRF2信号通路诱导乳腺癌铁死亡，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞实验与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ferroptosis, a regulated form of cell death characterized by iron accumulation and lipid peroxidation, has gained increasing attention as a therapeutic target in cancer. Polyethylene glycol-liposomal doxorubicin (PLD), a nanocarrier formulation with improved pharmacological properties, shows promise in breast cancer therapy, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying its effects on ferroptosis remain unclear. Breast cancer cell lines (MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7) were treated with PLD to evaluate its anti-tumor effects. Cell viability, colony formation, and migration assays were performed, while lipid ROS accumulation was assessed using BODIPY-C11, and oxidative stress markers (MDA, Fe, GSH, and SOD) were quantified. Western blotting and immunofluorescence were used to examine NRF2/xCT/GPX4 signaling, and molecular docking predicted the interactions of PLD with KEAP1 and NRF2. Functional roles were further validated through NRF2 overexpression and KEAP1-R483S mutation. PLD exerts potent anti-breast cancer effects by suppressing cell viability, colony formation, and migration in MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7 cells. Mechanistically, PLD induces ferroptosis, evidenced by increased lipid ROS, elevated MDA and Fe levels, decreased GSH content and SOD activity, and downregulation of xCT and GPX4. NRF2 overexpression attenuates these effects by restoring antioxidant defenses, reducing lipid peroxidation and iron accumulation, and partially rescuing cell proliferation and migration. Molecular docking further revealed stable interactions of PLD with KEAP1 and NRF2, with Arg483 identified as a key residue mediating KEAP1-NRF2 and PLD-KEAP1 binding, suggesting that KEAP1 modulates NRF2 stability and cellular susceptibility to ferroptosis. Collectively, these results indicate that PLD partially inhibits breast cancer growth through KEAP1/NRF2-mediated ferroptosis, highlighting a novel mechanism underlying its anti-tumor activity.
abstract_zh: 铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种以铁积累和脂质过氧化为特征的程序性细胞死亡形式，作为癌症治疗靶点日益受到关注。聚乙二醇脂质体多柔比星（PLD）是一种具有改善药理学特性的纳米载体制剂，在乳腺癌治疗中显示出前景，但其对铁死亡影响的分子机制仍不清楚。用PLD处理乳腺癌细胞系（MDA-MB-231和MCF-7）以评估其抗肿瘤效应。进行了细胞活力、集落形成和迁移实验，同时使用BODIPY-C11评估脂质活性氧（ROS）积累，并定量氧化应激标志物（MDA、Fe、GSH和SOD）。使用蛋白质印迹和免疫荧光检测NRF2/xCT/GPX4信号通路，分子对接预测了PLD与KEAP1和NRF2的相互作用。通过NRF2过表达和KEAP1-R483S突变进一步验证了功能作用。PLD通过抑制MDA-MB-231和MCF-7细胞的活力、集落形成和迁移，发挥强效抗乳腺癌作用。机制上，PLD诱导铁死亡，表现为脂质ROS增加、MDA和Fe水平升高、GSH含量和SOD活性降低，以及xCT和GPX4下调。NRF2过表达通过恢复抗氧化防御、减少脂质过氧化和铁积累，并部分挽救细胞增殖和迁移，从而减弱这些效应。分子对接进一步揭示了PLD与KEAP1和NRF2的稳定相互作用，其中Arg483被确定为介导KEAP1-NRF2和PLD-KEAP1结合的关键残基，提示KEAP1调节NRF2稳定性和细胞对铁死亡的敏感性。综合来看，这些结果表明PLD通过KEAP1/NRF2介导的铁死亡部分抑制乳腺癌生长，突显了其抗肿瘤活性的一种新机制。
